rics.description: Leading Index, Manufacturers new orders, consumer goods and materials
rics.meaning: Index of the Conference Board Leading Economic Index (LEI).
rics.how_to_use: Composite of 10 leading indicators. Sustained 6-month declines historically signal recession with 6-12 month lead. Was a false positive in 2022-23 (predicted recession that didn't arrive). Use alongside yield curve, not in isolation.
